text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per month within the richest decile

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per month within the richest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The chart shows breaks in the comparability of the underlying
household survey data over time within each country individually.

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes

text.tspan: and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
